title: Verify: Admin round handlers and route auth unit tests
summary: Handler tests with fake service and router 401 test
description: Test status mapping with a fake RoundService and auth on the mounted router.
acceptance_criteria: Router without token returns 401 for each admin round route
technical_constraints: httptest; server test uses config with t.TempDir repo path

steps.action: Fake RoundService returning configurable round/error; mount handlers on chi; assert POST /rounds body {"world_id":"w"} -> 201 JSON with status SCHEDULED; Close returning round.ErrIllegalTransition -> 409; Get returning round.ErrNotFound -> 404; malformed JSON -> 400; Contributions returns the fake list as JSON

Build the handler via New with Admin.Token "tok" and temp RepoPath; for POST /api/v1/admin/rounds, POST /api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001/open, POST .../close, GET .../ROUND-0000001, GET .../contributions assert 401 without header and not 401 with "Authorization: Bearer tok"
steps.expected: Router auth test passes (go test reports PASS)
